newsitem.title: USA: American says Boeing deal in jeopardy.
newsitem.headline: American says Boeing deal in jeopardy.

text.p: American Airlines President Donald Carty on Thursday said the carrier's bitter contract dispute with pilots meant it would not be able to take delivery of some Boeing Co jets next year as scheduled under a $6.5 billion contract.
"There will be some airplanes we expected to take in 1998 that we will not now be able to take," Carty told reporters. American is a unit of AMR Corp.
He said the entire contract for the delivery of 103 jets between 1998 and 2002 depended on a successful resolution, from the company's perspective, of the contract dispute.
